profile.headline: Sr. Devops Engineer
profile.summary: Why should you hire me? I am a versatile automation engineer with experience working with multiple server operating systems, switches and load balancers. I specialize in infrastructure automation, CI/CD and Cloud Management. Do you need to take manual processes and automate them? Do you need to glue multiple disparate systems/environments together? Do you need someone to develop automation with/for your ops teams? I'd be happy to talk to you.

positions.title: Systems Reliability Engineer II
positions.description:
- Develop new puppet modules to install and manage ServiceNow agent (for inventory and monitoring) and Garasign (code signing tool), and update existing modules for SentinelOne, Illumio, and other tools with new certificates, API keys, and deployment versions following team standards for idempotency, reducing manual effort and improving accuracy through consistent, code-driven deployments
- Update existing puppet modules handling application updates and deploy these updates to non-prod and prod environments
- Support legacy ruby applications, updating existing code base and write new deployment to Kubernetes using GitLab pipelines and custom helm charts, replacing manual deployment processes
- Create new and update existing application packages using Chocolatey on SonaType Nexus (Nuget) and createrepo (RHEL) and inutoc (AIX) on a mounted NFS share
- Migrate existing puppet modules to ansible playbooks as part of T-Mobile's company-wide initiative to improve maintainability
- Develop new and update recently migrated ansible playbooks to support new applications or updates to existing applications such as av agent updates or custom application updates, improving deployment speed and usability for other teams by removing support for outdated operating systems no longer used at T-Mobile
- Served as a go-to resource for newer team members, onboarding them to team responsibilities and providing subject matter expertise on Python and PowerShell scripting issues

positions.title: Sr. Devops Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected and managed a self-hosted GitLab instance on AWS, including IAM permissions, firewall rules, and update procedures; migrated from GitHub SaaS to reduce costs and gain control over outage management; deployed GitLab runners on EKS clusters; achieved zero unscheduled outages and enabled scheduled upgrades with zero impact on users.
- Reduced AWS costs by $10K/month by consolidating infrastructure for two winding-down mobile games (Kings Road and Alliance) from 10 regions to 3 regions and fewer servers.
- Replaced 40+ Elastic Beanstalk environments with consolidated EKS clusters, reducing server count from 80+ to 24 and significantly cutting operational overhead and costs.
- Created all deployment infrastructure for micro-service style deployments for the new game using Helm and GitLab CI, deploying to active/standby EKS clusters per region; performed zero-downtime releases by routing traffic via game version configuration, draining users over 24–48 hours before enforcing updates via app store, then performing maintenance on decommissioned clusters.
- Maintained and upgraded legacy Jenkins infrastructure for production deployments of Kings Road and Alliance, migrating from an outdated instance to a modern version to improve stability and security.
- Consolidated metrics and logging for k8s clusters by replacing Mimir and Loki with OpenObserve and OpenTelemetry agents, unifying metrics, logs, and tracing into a single platform to reduce operational complexity.
- Cloud Security management with Lacework
- Set up Kinesis Firehose to stream game event data (player thresholds, level completion times, in-game spend) to Redshift to enable reporting.

positions.title: Sr. Devops Engineer
positions.description:
- Create new and update existing IaC code using Terraform, Ansible and/or CloudFormation to deploy new services and modify existing ones by adding features like caching, adjusting scaling behavior, or changing underlying server types, reducing manual configuration
- Update older CloudFormation templates to Terraform as part of a larger effort to standardize on Terraform, improving deployment maintainability and reducing the number of pipelines needed while increasing consistency
- Test and deploy new or updated IaC using linting, dry runs, and test deployments to development or staging environments, managed through TeamCity pipelines
- Provide Tier 3 support for all build tooling such as TeamCity and Octopus and all AWS Environments, troubleshooting pipeline and deployment failures across environments, including issues that only surfaced in production despite successful dev testing

positions.title: Devops engineer
positions.description:
- Automated F5 Load Balancer configuration by integrating it into the website deployment process, eliminating manual steps and human error while speeding up deployments for new customer websites — previously done manually when hosting at Rackspace
- Created PowerShell module to consolidate multiple scripts into one place, simplifying deployments
- Migrate co-located SQL servers to AWS RDS using AWS Database Migration Service, reducing costs and improving uptime with only one hour of downtime and zero data loss; enabled splitting a single large database into multiple smaller servers, isolating larger clients on dedicated instances while keeping smaller and free-tier customers on shared databases
- Migrate co-located IIS servers to AWS ec2 instances, reducing costs and improving uptime with only one hour of downtime and zero data loss; eliminated reliance on Rackspace for hardware and networking issues
- Maintain/Add functionality to existing internal C#/asp.net management site
- Create proof of concept for running existing application in docker/Kubernetes in Azure using ACS-Engine(pre-AKS)
- Create proof of concepts for running existing applications via Amazon ECS and EKS
- Automate various internal functions for application deployment, maintenance and removal including IIS management, certificate management using Microsoft's Centralized Certificate Store to share certificates across multiple IIS servers via a centralized network share, replacing manual certificate installs on each server and reducing overhead, along with Route53 DNS and health checks, CloudWatch monitoring, New Relic alerting and Sumologic reporting, reducing manual effort by 50% and significantly cutting deployment time compared to manual configuration
- Enabled a free/trial tier by automating IIS deployments for new customers and assigning them to a shared database server for free-tier users, using Let's Encrypt to automatically provision SSL certificates without cost

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
- Write Python and PowerShell scripts to automate Linux and Windows server builds, reducing overall build time and errors
- Maintain multiple legacy Python based applications, providing support by fixing bugs, rewriting code to improve performance, and adding new reporting features to track number of servers built and build time for management decision-making
- Create C# based rest api to streamline processes by integrating with SCCM and System Center Orchestrator to automate tasks such as moving servers to correct OUs and updating collection memberships, reducing manual effort and increasing consistency
- Create System Center Orchestrator workflows to update windows base template monthly, ensuring compliance and saving many hours monthly by automating image creation across multiple Windows and Linux versions
- Act as general scripting and automation SME

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
- Create and maintain a PowerShell module for multi-team use currently containing over 50 functions for handling tasks including System Deployment, VMware management, Networking, and SharePoint automation; improved team efficiency by consolidating disparate scripts into one location, converting batch scripts to PowerShell for consistency, and adding new functionality such as updating SharePoint with documentation and enhancing the CMDB
- Create and maintain a C#-based ASP.NET Web API (REST API) backed by MS SQL Server that automates Dell TechDirect service requests and HP/Dell warranty management, including auto-creation of parts replacement tickets — saving hours previously spent manually creating tickets or calling in support. Also automates server build validation, replacing a manual process to improve consistency and reduce validation time.
- Create and maintain a limited scope server hardware CMDB as well as develop automation to keep it up to date; fully responsible for managing and updating the CMDB, integrating with vSphere, and tracking VMware hosts running Centurylink Cloud services
- Fully document PowerShell module. This includes keeping all the comment based help up to date as the API evolves and automating exporting that help as markdown for use on GitHub; creating functions that read comment-based help and output documentation to SharePoint, making updates as simple as editing comments and running a single function.

positions.title: Windows Devops Engineer
positions.description:
- Automated DYN DNS additions, updates, and removals, replacing a manual process and reducing errors while saving time
- Automated Load Balancer (F5) Pool creation and node allocation including iRule creation and monitor creation, replacing a manual process, reducing config mistakes, and speeding deployment
- Built a Server Allocation website (ASP.NET MVC C#) that reduced deployment time and errors while improving auditability by automating server configuration and providing real-time allocation reporting for freshly built Windows and Linux servers

positions.title: Unix Automation Engineer
positions.description:
- Deploy and administer Oracle Enterprise Linux, AIX, Solaris and HP-UX systems
- Write Puppet modules to manage various aspects of our servers
- Write Python-based application to automate VM creation by replacing a manual process that required cloning images, console-based IP configuration, and step-by-step server prep; automated network setup via VMware Tools, Puppet installation, and configuration, reducing deployment time from 1 hour to minutes and enabling deployment of tens to hundreds of servers at once
- Write Python-based REST API for Infoblox DNS to automatically create DNS records during server provisioning, integrated with VM automation and used by both automation and build teams, reducing errors and saving time by eliminating manual DNS entry which was frequently forgotten or prone to typos
- Write unit and integration tests
- Set up CI pipeline for internal applications using Jenkins and Docker, used by VM build automation and other internal tools, enabling test-before-production deployments to validate changes before release
- Bug fixes and feature requests to existing internal python and ruby applications
- Creation and management of CoreOS servers and docker containers
- Use Ansible and Ansible Tower to auto-configure servers after initial OS deployment; wrote playbooks to deploy security agents and other tools required by application teams, replacing manual configuration processes

positions.title: SCCM Engineer
positions.description:
- Created a web interface and integrated API to automate VLAN assignment for physical servers during OS deployment, eliminating manual networking tickets by allowing system engineers to directly assign application-specific VLANs on network switches via SCCM during IP assignment, after previously relying on a slow ticketing process that delayed hundreds of server builds
- Created a C# API to automate DHCP reservation creation and deletion for static IP servers, and extended the same automation to out-of-band management ports such as iDRAC and HP iLO, reducing human error and speeding up server provisioning
- Provided reporting and metrics for server build processes, tracking batch progress, success/error rates, and acting as a mini-CMDB with details on installed software, network configuration, out-of-band access, CPU, memory, and storage for all built servers

positions.title: Senior Systems Administrator
positions.description:
- Led migration of SCCM from the production network segment to a dedicated Management domain, enhancing security through improved network segregation, fully relocating the SCCM infrastructure, and reducing risk while improving compliance
- Created Task Sequences for Windows physical server builds, improving deployment speed and consistency, reducing errors, and adding support for new Windows versions and agents
- Re-wrote CMD scripts into PowerShell to improve reliability and consistency, enable new automation, and align with a department-wide initiative to phase out legacy scripting

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
- Provide Tier 3 support to Federal customers using the Service Now product, resolving issues they had with the tool and coordinating scheduled downtime for patching
- Patch Federal customer servers using internal scripts and applications to keep servers up to date with security patches, reducing vulnerabilities and maintaining compliance with NIST

positions.title: Automation Engineer at Xbox Live
positions.description:
- Created a web interface and web services in C# and ASP.NET with a SQL and Orchestrator workflow engine backend, enabling project managers to deploy and decommission servers by uploading a CSV file — replacing a manual, team-intensive process that limited us to 30 servers/day; at peak, this allowed batches of up to 400 servers to be deployed in hours, compared to days previously, and shifted the workload to a self-service model requiring only occasional troubleshooting from my team; the interface also provided real-time metrics and reports so project managers could track server batch status, success/failure rates, and build throughput
- Automated static IP assignment for hundreds of servers daily using System Center Orchestrator and IPAM, eliminating manual selection by our team and saving hours of team and project manager time each week—savings scaled with server volume.
- Provided Tier 3 hardware and operating system support for 30,000+ Windows servers, handling incidents, escalations, and root-cause analysis across multiple environments.
- Deployed and maintained SCCM task sequences for software and OS updates across hundreds of servers daily, troubleshooting OS deployment failures at scale to ensure consistent and reliable deployments.
- Participated in a 24/7 on-call rotation, being on call every 3-4 weeks for a week, responding to critical outages and improving system uptime during off-hours.

positions.title: Sr. Data Analyst at Xbox Live
positions.description:
- Design Operating System Deployment Task Sequences to improve efficiency. 
- Developed an automated process to build new syspreped 'Fat WIMs' using SCVMM, SCCM, and Orchestrator, shifting from irregular updates to a monthly scheduled process that ensured all deployed images were always up to date with the latest security patches and allowed us to test patch changes before production deployment
- Deploy server operating systems via System Center Configuration Manager
- Troubleshoot OS deployment issues. 
- Write scripts using PowerShell or VBS to automate repetitive tasks and configure operating systems during deployment
- Create or update task sequences for deployment of new operating system versions
- Provide Tier 3 hardware and Operating System support for multiple environment and thousands of servers

positions.title: Support Engineer 2 at Xbox Live
positions.description:
- Provided Tier 3 hardware and operating system support for 30,000+ Windows servers, handling incidents, escalations, and root-cause analysis across multiple environments.
- Deployed and maintained SCCM task sequences for software and OS updates across hundreds of servers daily, troubleshooting OS deployment failures at scale to ensure consistent and reliable deployments.
- Participated in a 24/7 on-call rotation, being on call every 3-4 weeks for a week, responding to critical outages and improving system uptime during off-hours.

positions.title: Information Technology Specialist
positions.description: Provide hardware and software support for 20 clients. Manage backups. Implement an Active Directory domain and Exchange mail server. Manage login scripts. Upgrade phone system from standard pbx to a VoIP (asterisk based) system.

positions.title: Technical Analyst
positions.description: Provide hardware and software support for 600+ users. Manage and maintain PC and Laptop images using Sysprep and Acronis TrueImage. Managed Dell lease schedule. Design web interface for internal computer auditing software. Design intranet application for tracking computers and devices.

positions.title: Technician
positions.description: Travel to client locations to fix various network and computer related issues. Provide phone support for clients. Implement Active Directory domains and Exchange servers for various organizations. Deploy Microsoft VPN technologies for client offices. Set up and configure IpSwitch Whatsup Gold network and server monitoring solution.

projects.title: OSD Automation for Xbox Live
projects.description: I deployed a centrally managed SCCM solution whith which they can manage all of their test and production environments from. This solution gives them the bility to deploy fully configured operating systems allong with all applications (such as IIS, and SQL) also fully configured to roughly 600 servers in 90 minutes.
